channel.title: Cyber Threat Wall — Latest Movers
channel.description: Actively exploited vulnerabilities rising fastest in Cyber Threat Wall rankings.

item.title: CVE-2025-61884 — Oracle E-Business Suite
item.description: Threat Signal 86. Oracle E-Business Suite contains a server-side request forgery (SSRF) vulnerability in the Runtime component of Oracle Configurator. This vulnerability is remotely exploitable without authentication.

item.title: CVE-2025-8088 — RARLAB WinRAR
item.description: Threat Signal 86. RARLAB WinRAR contains a path traversal vulnerability affecting the Windows version of WinRAR. This vulnerability could allow an attacker to execute arbitrary code by crafting malicious archive files.

item.title: CVE-2024-21412 — Microsoft Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 86. Microsoft Windows Internet Shortcut Files contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for a security feature bypass.

item.title: CVE-2024-21893 — Ivanti Connect Secure, Policy Secure, and Neurons
item.description: Threat Signal 86. Ivanti Connect Secure (ICS, formerly known as Pulse Connect Secure), Ivanti Policy Secure, and Ivanti Neurons contain a server-side request forgery (SSRF) vulnerability in the SAML component that allows an attacker to access certain restricted resources without authentication.

item.title: CVE-2023-46805 — Ivanti Connect Secure and Policy Secure
item.description: Threat Signal 86. Ivanti Connect Secure (ICS, formerly known as Pulse Connect Secure) and Ivanti Policy Secure gateways contain an authentication bypass vulnerability in the web component that allows an attacker to access restricted resources by bypassing control checks. This vulnerability can be leveraged in conjunction with CVE-2024-21887, a command injection vulnerability.

item.title: CVE-2023-40044 — Progress WS_FTP Server
item.description: Threat Signal 86. Progress WS_FTP Server contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability in the Ad Hoc Transfer module that allows an authenticated attacker to execute remote commands on the underlying operating system.

item.title: CVE-2023-38831 — RARLAB WinRAR
item.description: Threat Signal 86. RARLAB WinRAR contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows an attacker to execute code when a user attempts to view a benign file within a ZIP archive.

item.title: CVE-2017-11357 — Telerik User Interface (UI) for ASP.NET AJAX
item.description: Threat Signal 86. Telerik UI for ASP.NET AJAX contains an insecure direct object reference vulnerability in RadAsyncUpload that can result in file uploads in a limited location and/or remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2022-41082 — Microsoft Exchange Server
item.description: Threat Signal 86. Microsoft Exchange Server contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for authenticated remote code execution. Dubbed "ProxyNotShell," this vulnerability is chainable with CVE-2022-41040 which allows for the remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2022-27593 — QNAP Photo Station
item.description: Threat Signal 86. Certain QNAP NAS running Photo Station with internet exposure contain an externally controlled reference to a resource vulnerability which can allow an attacker to modify system files. This vulnerability was observed being utilized in a Deadbolt ransomware campaign.

item.title: CVE-2022-30190 — Microsoft Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 86. A remote code execution vulnerability exists when MSDT is called using the URL protocol from a calling application such as Word. An attacker who successfully exploits this vulnerability can run code with the privileges of the calling application.

item.title: CVE-2017-0148 — Microsoft SMBv1 server
item.description: Threat Signal 86. The SMBv1 server in Microsoft allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code via crafted packets.

item.title: CVE-2021-28799 — QNAP Network Attached Storage (NAS)
item.description: Threat Signal 86. QNAP NAS running HBS 3 contains an improper authorization vulnerability which can allow remote attackers to log in to a device.

item.title: CVE-2017-12615 — Apache Tomcat
item.description: Threat Signal 86. When running Apache Tomcat on Windows with HTTP PUTs enabled, it is possible to upload a JSP file to the server via a specially crafted request. This JSP could then be requested and any code it contained would be executed by the server.

item.title: CVE-2017-0146 — Microsoft Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 86. The SMBv1 server in Microsoft Windows allows remote attackers to perform remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2008-2992 — Adobe Acrobat and Reader
item.description: Threat Signal 86. Adobe Acrobat and Reader contain an input validation issue in a JavaScript method that could potentially lead to remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2017-0145 — Microsoft SMBv1
item.description: Threat Signal 86. The SMBv1 server in multiple Microsoft Windows versions allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code via crafted packets.

item.title: CVE-2021-42321 — Microsoft Exchange
item.description: Threat Signal 86. An authenticated attacker could leverage improper validation in cmdlet arguments within Microsoft Exchange and perform remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2018-6789 — Exim Exim
item.description: Threat Signal 86. Exim contains a buffer overflow vulnerability in the base64d function part of the SMTP listener that may allow for remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2017-11882 — Microsoft Office
item.description: Threat Signal 86. Microsoft Office contains a memory corruption vulnerability that allows remote code execution in the context of the current user.

item.title: CVE-2017-0199 — Microsoft Office and WordPad
item.description: Threat Signal 86. Microsoft Office and WordPad contain an unspecified vulnerability due to the way the applications parse specially crafted files. Successful exploitation allows for remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2021-27065 — Microsoft Exchange Server
item.description: Threat Signal 86. Microsoft Exchange Server contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for remote code execution. This vulnerability is part of the ProxyLogon exploit chain.

item.title: CVE-2026-20079 — Cisco Secure Firewall Management Center (FMC) and Security Cloud Control (SCC) Firewall Management
item.description: Threat Signal 85. Cisco Secure Firewall Management Center (FMC) Software and Cisco Security Cloud Control (SCC) Firewall Management contain an authentication Bypass using an alternate path or channel vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to bypass authentication and execute script files on an affected device to obtain root access to the underlying operating system.

item.title: CVE-2024-57726 — SimpleHelp SimpleHelp
item.description: Threat Signal 85. SimpleHelp contains a missing authorization vulnerability that could allow low-privileged technicians to create API keys with excessive permissions. These API keys can be used to escalate privileges to the server admin role.

item.title: CVE-2023-4966 — Citrix NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway
item.description: Threat Signal 85. Citrix NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway contain a buffer overflow vulnerability that allows for sensitive information disclosure when configured as a Gateway (VPN virtual server, ICA Proxy, CVPN, RDP Proxy) or AAA virtual server.

item.title: CVE-2023-36884 — Microsoft Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 85. Microsoft Windows Search contains an unspecified vulnerability that could allow an attacker to evade Mark of the Web (MOTW) defenses via a specially crafted malicious file, leading to remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2022-30333 — RARLAB UnRAR
item.description: Threat Signal 85. RARLAB UnRAR on Linux and UNIX contains a directory traversal vulnerability, allowing an attacker to write to files during an extract (unpack) operation.

item.title: CVE-2021-4034 — Red Hat Polkit
item.description: Threat Signal 85. The Red Hat polkit pkexec utility contains an out-of-bounds read and write vulnerability that allows for privilege escalation with administrative rights.

item.title: CVE-2017-0147 — Microsoft SMBv1 server
item.description: Threat Signal 85. The SMBv1 server in Microsoft Windows allows remote attackers to obtain sensitive information from process memory via a crafted packet.

item.title: CVE-2018-20250 — RARLAB WinRAR
item.description: Threat Signal 85. WinRAR Absolute Path Traversal vulnerability leads to Remote Code Execution

item.title: CVE-2017-10271 — Oracle WebLogic Server
item.description: Threat Signal 85. Oracle Corporation WebLogic Server contains a vulnerability that allows for remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2021-42258 — BQE BillQuick Web Suite
item.description: Threat Signal 85. BQE BillQuick Web Suite contains an SQL injection vulnerability when accessing the username parameter that may allow for unauthenticated, remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2018-0802 — Microsoft Office
item.description: Threat Signal 85. Microsoft Office contains a memory corruption vulnerability due to the way objects are handled in memory. Successful exploitation allows for remote code execution in the context of the current user. This vulnerability is known to be chained with CVE-2018-0798.

item.title: CVE-2021-26858 — Microsoft Exchange Server
item.description: Threat Signal 85. Microsoft Exchange Server contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for remote code execution. This vulnerability is part of the ProxyLogon exploit chain.

item.title: CVE-2021-26857 — Microsoft Exchange Server
item.description: Threat Signal 85. Microsoft Exchange Server contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for remote code execution. This vulnerability is part of the ProxyLogon exploit chain.

item.title: CVE-2019-7481 — SonicWall SMA100
item.description: Threat Signal 85. SonicWall SMA100 contains a SQL injection vulnerability allowing an unauthenticated user to gain read-only access to unauthorized resources.

item.title: CVE-2024-57727 — SimpleHelp SimpleHelp
item.description: Threat Signal 84. SimpleHelp remote support software contains multiple path traversal vulnerabilities that allow unauthenticated remote attackers to download arbitrary files from the SimpleHelp host via crafted HTTP requests. These files may include server configuration files and hashed user passwords.

item.title: CVE-2023-28461 — Array Networks AG/vxAG ArrayOS
item.description: Threat Signal 84. Array Networks AG and vxAG ArrayOS contain a missing authentication for critical function vulnerability that allows an attacker to read local files and execute code on the SSL VPN gateway.

item.title: CVE-2022-36537 — ZK Framework AuUploader
item.description: Threat Signal 84. ZK Framework AuUploader servlets contain an unspecified vulnerability that could allow an attacker to retrieve the content of a file located in the web context. The ZK Framework is an open-source Java framework. This vulnerability can impact multiple products, including but not limited to ConnectWise R1Soft Server Backup Manager.

item.title: CVE-2023-0669 — Fortra GoAnywhere MFT
item.description: Threat Signal 84. Fortra (formerly, HelpSystems) GoAnywhere MFT contains a pre-authentication remote code execution vulnerability in the License Response Servlet due to deserializing an attacker-controlled object.

item.title: CVE-2022-27925 — Synacor Zimbra Collaboration Suite (ZCS)
item.description: Threat Signal 84. Synacor Zimbra Collaboration Suite (ZCS) contains flaw in the mboximport functionality, allowing an authenticated attacker to upload arbitrary files to perform remote code execution. This vulnerability was chained with CVE-2022-37042 which allows for unauthenticated remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2016-0189 — Microsoft Internet Explorer
item.description: Threat Signal 84. The Microsoft JScript nd VBScript engines, as used in Internet Explorer and other products, allow attackers to execute remote code or cause a denial of service (memory corruption) via a crafted web site.

item.title: CVE-2010-0188 — Adobe Reader and Acrobat
item.description: Threat Signal 84. Unspecified vulnerability in Adobe Reader and Acrobat allows attackers to cause a denial of service or possibly execute arbitrary code.

item.title: CVE-2018-15982 — Adobe Flash Player
item.description: Threat Signal 84. Adobe Flash Player com.adobe.tvsdk.mediacore.metadata Use After Free Vulnerability

item.title: CVE-2018-4878 — Adobe Flash Player
item.description: Threat Signal 84. Adobe Flash Player contains a use-after-free vulnerability that could allow for code execution.

item.title: CVE-2021-26411 — Microsoft Internet Explorer
item.description: Threat Signal 84. Microsoft Internet Explorer contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for memory corruption.

item.title: CVE-2019-11539 — Ivanti Pulse Connect Secure and Pulse Policy Secure
item.description: Threat Signal 84. Ivanti Pulse Connect Secure and Policy Secure allows an authenticated attacker from the admin web interface to inject and execute commands.

item.title: CVE-2026-76460 — Cisco Identity Services Engine
item.description: Threat Signal 70. Cisco Identity Services Engine (ISE) and Cisco ISE Passive Identity Connector (ISE-PIC) contain an incorrect use of privileged APIs vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to gain unauthorized access to the affected device by bypassing the web-based management interface.

item.title: CVE-2026-86218 — N-able N-central
item.description: Threat Signal 70. N-able N-central contains a static code injection vulnerability that could allow for pre-authentication remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2026-82329 — JFrog Artifactory
item.description: Threat Signal 70. JFrog Artifactory contains an improper authentication vulnerability that under default configuration can allow an unauthenticated attacker with network access to obtain administrative privileges.
